messages:
Maya (PM): Quick thread: defining deprecation checkpoints for prompt-compat shim. We need a runnable plan that balances mobile/customer needs and our long-term messages-first API.
Ethan (Eng): TL;DR: support prompt shim as opt-in header for limited time, migrate default to messages. Main engineering tasks: validator, canonicalizer, SDK helpers, telemetry.
Olivia (CS): Customer ask (from Priya): mobile app uses tiny clients that cannot ship changes quickly. They asked for a guaranteed opt-out window.
Priya (Customer): (pinned) we need 9 months notice + an admin toggle. Mobile SDKs are on a slow cadence.
Maya (PM): Noted. Proposal: 6 months opt-in compatibility window + extension by request (admin opt-out) on per-org basis for up to +9 months. We'll require security signoff for extensions.
Sam (Security): Security caveat: prompt strings are harder to audit for role injection. If we allow extended opt-outs, require per-org audit logs and content-scan flag enabled. Also forbid unknown roles when we canonicalize.
Rina (ML): Behavior nuance: deterministic canonicalization matters. We must document exact conversion rules so model output remains reproducible. Rules: split by sentences? no. Use newline markers and explicit role tokens. Example conversion: 
```
prompt: "System: You are a helpful assistant.\nUser: Summarize this..."
-> messages: [{role:'system',content:'You are a helpful assistant.'},{role:'user',content:'Summarize this...'}]
```
And we must reject ambiguous fragments.
Jia (DevEx): SDK helpers: messages.fromPrompt(prompt, {systemPrefix:'System:'}) and warn about token delta. Also include a CLI tool to diff tokens between modes. We'll ship JS + Py helpers in alpha.
Tom (Eng-Platform): Telemetry: add boolean header 'x-ri-prompt-compat: 1' to mark shim use. Also capture 'conversion_delta_tokens' and 'canonicalizer_version' for A/B analysis. Flag rollout via FF per org.
Ethan (Eng): API contract rules: 
1) If messages present -> canonical.
2) If prompt present and no messages -> convert using canonicalizer V1.
3) If both present -> 400 with error code RI-AMBIGUOUS.
4) If prompt used without header -> reject (enforce opt-in).
(we'll document error codes).
Olivia (CS): Acceptance criteria for beta: 3 customers (mobile, legal-search, support-bot) run their flows for 2 weeks; no >2% divergence in intent classification and a token cost delta <15% for typical queries.
Rina (ML): Add 'response_format' param for structured outputs (values: text, json_schema). When json_schema requested ensure model side validates output shape and we emit schema-violation metrics.
Maya (PM): Launch gates: spec + SDKs + telemetry + security audit + beta signoffs. Need E2E perf: p95 latency no more than 10% above current baseline.
Ethan (Eng): Timeline: sprint 1 -> canonicalizer + validator + SDK alpha. sprint 2 -> telemetry + FF + beta rollout infra. Risk: token count surprises; mitigation: show token delta in response headers and warn customers.
Jia (DevEx): Docs backlog: migration guide, quick-fix snippets for mobile, sample requests for function calling with both modes, and a migration checklist for CS.
Sam (Security): For extensions we require org admin to enable 'prompt-compat-legacy' and agree to enhanced logging for the period. We will auto-expire the toggle unless explicitly renewed.
Priya (Customer): That sounds workable. We'll volunteer to be a beta org.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ethan PR spec by Tue, Jia draft SDK helpers by Wed, Tom add telemetry fields by Wed, Sam draft extension policy, Olivia schedule beta with Priya. Reconvene Mon morning.
Ethan (Eng): I'll include sample canonicalizer test vectors in the PR.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: api/canonicalizer-v1 -> staging
